notes.title: 🚀September 2025 Update 🚀: 🧰 TileForge Is Here!
notes.content:
[p][/p][p][b]Hey Realms fam![/b] [/p][p]                             We’ve been a bit quiet since the July mega update—because we’ve been heads‑down building. Today we’re rolling out new tools, navigation upgrades, clearer docs, and important Steam release clarifications. Let’s get into it. ✨

[b]Watch the in-Depth Update Video Here:[/b] [dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/9wzaHniRhpQ?si=yff-ZCCW0kHch6Ay"][/dynamiclink][/p][hr][/hr][h1]🚀 What’s New[/h1][p][/p][h2][b]🧭 New 3D ViewCube (Viewport)[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]Navigate big builds faster and with more precision:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Click [b]faces/corners[/b] to snap to ortho or isometric views[/p][/*][*][p]Drag the cube to orbit the camera[/p][/*][*][p]Lightweight, always‑available navigation to reduce camera friction[/p][/*][*][p]Especially helpful for large scenes and precision placement workflows[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]🧰 TileForge Is Here (Not STL Forge)[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Meet [b]TileForge[/b]—our in‑editor tile customizer for Hex Crafter that lets you craft custom tiles and tile groups.[/p][p][b]Where to find it:[/b] Open Hex Crafter and use the top menu icon, or jump to the new [b]“Custom Tiles”[/b] tab in the Toolbox.[/p][p][b]How it works:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Create a tile or group with the look you want—mix terrain types, blend materials, place props[/p][/*][*][p][b]Save[/b]—your creations appear in [b]Toolbox → Custom Tiles[/b] for instant reuse[/p][/*][*][p][b]Edit[/b] anytime via the [b]Edit[/b] button (top‑right of each thumbnail)—iterate without losing placements[/p][/*][*][p][b]Publish to Steam Workshop[/b] to share your creations with the community[/p][/*][/list][quote][p]⚠️ [b]Clarification:[/b] TileForge ≠ STL Forge. TileForge is for in‑engine customization [b]inside Hex Crafter[/b]. STL Forge is a [b]separate (coming soon)[/b] tool focused on [b]printable[/b] tiles. [/p][h3][b]TileForge Tiles are not 3D Printable.[/b][/h3][/quote][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]📚 New: MoR Manual (Living Documentation)[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]We’ve launched a Manual on the website—a living guide that grows with the product.
[b]Manual:[/b] [/p][p][url="https://www.masterofrealms.com/mor-ea-11-manual"]https://www.masterofrealms.com/mor-ea-11-manual[/url][/p][p]
____________________________________________________________________[/p][p][/p][h2][b]📜Patch Notes — 0.8 TileForge Update[/b][/h2][p][b]Hex Crafter upgrades, faster Toolbox, and stability fixes[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Added:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Credits:[/b] VIP Backers names list added to the in-app Credits page.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Reworked Saving System (Hex Crafter):[/b] Faster, more reliable saves.[/p][/*][*][p][b]TileForge UX tweaks:[/b] Smoother create/edit flow inside Hex Crafter.[/p][/*][*][p][b]TileForge mode (Hex Crafter):[/b] Create custom tiles and tile groups directly in-engine; non-destructive edit and reuse.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Themes in Toolbox:[/b] Themes are now browsable and [b]placeable[/b] directly from the Toolbox.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Optimized Toolbox:[/b] Faster load and scrolling for large libraries; improved responsiveness.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New & improved Data Management workflow:[/b] Behind-the-scenes refactor for safer saves, cleaner data, and fewer edge-case errors.[/p][/*][*][p][b]3D ViewCube gizmo:[/b] Click faces/edges/corners to snap to ortho/iso; drag to orbit; [b]Home[/b] to reset.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Fixed:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]DX12 startup crash:[/b] Resolved crash on launch when running under DirectX 12.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Video capture static lead-in:[/b] Removed the long static at the beginning of captured videos.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Country tiles not loading correctly:[/b] Fixed Toolbox population for country tiles [b]and related categories[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Path/River intersections:[/b] Corrected overlap/connectivity behavior.
[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h1]🧨 Steam Release — Clarifications[/h1][p][/p][p]To set expectations and reduce confusion:[/p][list][*][p][b]Final Steam keys:[/b] You will receive [b]permanent product keys[/b] (separate from playtest keys) at release. These add the base product to your library.[/p][/*][*][p][b]DLC entitlements:[/b] Themes & feature DLCs are already granted for Kickstarter backers via BackerKit according to pledge tier. Expect a [b]second email with DLC keys at release[/b] (keys may arrive within a short window; they’re tied to your pledge).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Backer access:[/b] All backers will receive the Steam release according to their pledge‑tier benefits. If your tier includes specific themes/features, those will be included via DLC keys.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Kickstarter “Delivered” status:[/b] We are [b]considering marking the Kickstarter as Delivered at the time of the Steam release[/b] to reflect fulfillment of your pledged rewards via Steam keys. [b]This will not stop updates[/b]—we’ll continue shipping improvements, fixes, and any content you’re entitled to. You’ll keep receiving updates to everything you’ve received, of course.[/p][/*][/list][p]If your email has changed or you don’t receive keys at launch, please open a ticket in [b]Discord → Support[/b] so we can reissue promptly.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h1]🗺️ Create, Share, Get Featured[/h1][p][/p][p]With TileForge + Hex Crafter, you can now build faster and smarter:[/p][list][*][p]Combine core themes with your own custom sets to prototype biomes[/p][/*][*][p]Reuse saved groups across projects to speed up workflows[/p][/*][*][p]Post screenshots in [b]Hall of Exhibits[/b] on Discord for a chance to be featured in [b]#🐐‑vault‑of‑legends[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Tag us on socials—community spotlights are live and ongoing[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h1]🛠️ Feedback & Support[/h1][p][/p][list][*][p]Report bugs/crashes via the in‑app reporter or [b]Discord → Support Channels[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Share feature requests in [b]#feedback[/b]—QoL wins are prioritized for upcoming hotfixes[/p][/*][*][p]We’re tracking known issues and pushing incremental fixes[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h1]🔮 What’s Next[/h1][p][/p][list][*][p][b]All Themed Tile Groups[/b] hooked and working inside the application (final QA pass underway)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Chunking content into DLCs[/b] and preparing distribution for keys & bundles (store metadata, entitlement checks)[/p][/*][*][p]Continued performance profiling[/p][/*][*][p]Quality‑of‑life passes[/p][/*][*][p]Hotfix window for any regressions introduced by new additions[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h1]🌟 Almost There![/h1][p][/p][p]                We’re getting very close to the Steam launch phase. From a small prototype to a growing toolkit, we’ve only reached this milestone because you believed in the vision.[/p][p]As noted above, we’re [b]considering marking the Kickstarter as Delivered alongside the Steam release[/b] to reflect fulfillment through your keys. [b]That doesn’t end development[/b]—we’ll keep rolling out updates, improvements, and any pledged content you’ve received.[/p][p]Thank you for riding along—testing builds, sending feedback, and cheering us on. 🙌
Please keep sharing your thoughts and creations; your support is what turns the future of [b]Master of Realms[/b] into reality. 💙
[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h1][u]📢 Join Our Community![/u][/h1][p][b][url="https://discord.gg/JSEM5xQbt5" style="button" buttoncolor="#5d66f6"]Discord[/url]  [url="https://www.facebook.com/MasterofRealms/" style="button"]Facebook[/url][/b]  [b][url="https://x.com/masterofrealm" style="button" buttoncolor="#000000"]X[/url][/b]  [b][url="https://www.instagram.com/masterofrealms" style="button" buttoncolor="#fb3737"]Instagram[/url][/b][/p][p]Stay updated with the latest news and releases, share your maps and creations, and connect with fellow adventurers.[/p][p]— The Master of Realms Team[/p]

notes.title: Master of Realms v0.6.3 is LIVE!
notes.content:
[b]Hello Realm Builders![/b] 🌍✨

We're excited to roll out [b]Update v0.6.3[/b], bringing major upgrades to our lake/water systems, wall tool logic, and more visual polish across your world-building experience!

[hr][/hr]

[h2]💧 Reimagined Water Tools[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Lake Tool stability greatly improved[/b] – smoother, more responsive editing
[*][b]Jagged coastal tile variations[/b] – no more straight, artificial edges
[*][b]Rivers now intersect coastlines and flow into lakes[/b] for seamless water connectivity
[*][b]WaterFill Tool[/b] has been restored as a separate draw type for more precision
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]🏰 Wall & City Tools – Now with Gates![/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Wall/City Tool improvements[/b] – more stable and intuitive
[*][b]Paths and City Roads can now intersect with Walls[/b] to create automatic gates!
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]📦 Upcoming Tile Sets[/h2]
Our [b]Desert, Dwarven, and Elven tile sets[/b] are ready!  
We'll share visuals in the coming days, and these sets will be available with our [b]1.0 launch on Steam[/b], once we complete chunking and distribution setup.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]🎓 New Tutorials Incoming[/h2]
With all these updates, we know you’ll need guidance.  
We’re creating [b]fresh tutorials[/b] to help you master the latest tools, features, and workflows.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]📋 Changelog[/h2]
For the full patch notes, head to our [url=#changelog]Patch Notes section below[/url].

[expand type=details expanded=false][h2=name]Changelog – v0.6.3[/h2]

[b]Added:[/b]
[list]
[*] River–Lake intersection support
[*] City Wall–Path intersection support (auto-gate generation!)
[*] Major Lake Tool improvements
[*] Jagged Coastal Tile variations added to the Toolbox
[/list]

[b]Fixed:[/b]
[list]
[*] Missing animations when drawing over empty tiles
[*] Lake and Wall Tile Drawing bugs
[*] Fixed inputs being locked after controlling a character
[/list]
[/expand]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]💬 Feedback & Support[/h2]
Please be patient with support as we handle ongoing feedback and fixes.  
Your reports help us improve faster – keep them coming!

Join the community: [url=https://discord.gg/VXeyxytZdh style=button]Join Our Discord[/url]

Thanks for your continued support, and we’ll see you in the Realms! 🎲

notes.title: Master of Realms – Patch 0.6.0 is Here for Playtesters!
notes.content:
[h1]Master of Realms – Patch 0.6.0 is Live![/h1]

[h3][b]Patch 0.6.0[/b] is one of our biggest yet, [b]introducing powerful new [i]experimental tools[/i][/b], [b]custom image export, MacOS support, and a compatibility layer[/b] to keep your maps safe in future updates.[/h3]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]🛠️ Highlights[/h2]

[list]
[*][b]City Tool (Previously Wall Tool) (Experimental)[/b] – Build cities in seconds! Wall tool is now City Tool and now this tool automatically places wall tiles along the perimeter and fills the interior with city filler tiles. You can even use it to create standalone walls by setting the radius to 0.

[*][b]Lake Fill Tool (Experimental)[/b] – Draw on ground tiles to auto-place coastal tiles on edges and water tiles in the middle.

[*][b]Digital Export[/b] – Export full-resolution images of your maps with custom grid sizes.

[*][h2]🍎 MacOS Support (Early Build)[/h2]

We're rolling out initial support for Mac users!
[list]
[*][b]Tested On:[/b] Mac Mini M2 Pro
[*][b]Minimum Requirement:[/b] Mac with a Metal-compatible GPU
[*][b]Recommended OS:[/b] macOS 13.0 or later
[/list]

This is an early access build for Mac — some features may be limited or buggy. Please report any issues and help us refine the experience!


[*][b]Compatibility Layer[/b] – Ensures older maps remain compatible with future tag and feature updates.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]✅ Added[/h2]

[list]
[*] City Tool (Experimental)
[*] Lake Fill Tool (Experimental)
[*] Digital Export feature (custom grid-size image export)
[*] City Wall tile randomization
[*] MacOS platform support
[*] Compatibility Layer for tag upgrades and legacy map support
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]🐞 Fixes & Improvements[/h2]

[list]
[*] Reworked and optimized lighting system
[*] Fixed tile edge sorting issues
[*] Fixed potential character memory leaks
[*] Fixed screenshot saving bug after Unreal 5.5 upgrade
[*] Improved tag validation logic
[*] Fixed several fatal error triggers
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

Thanks as always for your support and feedback! More smart draw tools and workflow improvements are on the way.

[h1]📜 Read the full update on Kickstarter:[/h1] [h1][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/kingdomoftiradom/master-of-realmstm/posts/4365134]Click here[/url][/h1]

notes.title: Master of Realms – Patch 0.5.3 Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Patch 0.5.3 is here with a major engine upgrade, usability improvements, bug fixes, and new content based on your feedback. Thank you for your continued support! 💙

[hr][/hr]

[h2]🔧 Changes & Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Upgraded to Unreal Engine 5.5.2 for better performance and stability.
[*] Wall Single objects are now available in the toolbox! 🏗️
[*] Disabled water reflection during 2D Export for better clarity.
[*] Added confirmation message when saving settings.
[*] Disabled Vignette on 2D Export for sharper visuals.
[*] Added confirmation popup when exiting using Alt + F4 to prevent accidental closures.
[*] "R" key now enters rotation mode for any draw type on objects and tiles.
[*] Steam Workshop logic improved and cleaned up for a smoother experience.
[*] Mouse-centered zoom with ALT + Scroll is now implemented.
[*] Tile draw rotation now uses "R" instead of mouse scroll (scroll remains for zooming).
[*] Draw type buttons now auto-hide when not needed to declutter the UI.
[*] Fixed various texture issues improving visual consistency.
[*] Multiple tile fixes to improve alignment and placement accuracy.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]🐞 Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a fatal error when deleting a tile with objects on it.
[*] Fixed Steam Workshop crashes.
[*] Fixed Viewbox interaction issues with zoom and navigation.
[*] Fixed crash when pressing "G" or "CTRL + D" while rotating a tile.
[*] Fixed Country Path intersections.
[*] Fixed distance culling issue for meshes with foliage (Forest Tiles).
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]🆕 Additional Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Scaled Tile STLs will be available shortly after this update! Based on Discord polls, scaled up for better usability.
[*] Linux Build is now available! 🐧 Some features may have bugs or be unavailable for now.
[*] Mac Build is coming soon! 🍏 Stay tuned for updates.
[/list]
[hr][/hr]

[h2]💬 Help Us Improve![/h2]
Your feedback is invaluable—please report bugs, crashes, or unexpected behavior so we can continue making MoR even better!

notes.title: Master of Realms – Patch v0.5.2
notes.content:
[h2]Changes & Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*]Decals now fade out close to camera to improve visibility
[*]Reworked Grid size manipulation with dragging
[*]Camera can now be zoomed with UI buttons
[*]Added Bridges
[*]Disabled map renaming while inside of a map
[/list]

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed map loading issues and added a failsafe if map fails to load
[*]Fixed map rename widget having empty text field
[*]Fixed Windowed mode resize jitter
[*]Fixed objects disappearing when deleting unrelated objects
[*]Fixed walls orientation for path draw
[*]Fixed objects floating/disappearing after duplication
[*]Disabled Square Grid button when creating a map
[*]Fixed default keybinds for changing radius size
[*]Fixed FPS limiter having conflicts with FSR frame interpolation
[*]Updated texture pool size
[*]Fixed "Default" tooltip on welcome screen
[*]Fixed UI issues in tutorial
[*]Added a failsafe for VRAM detection to help with crashes
[*]Turned on Temporal Upsampling to avoid compatibility issues with DLSS and black screen crashes
[*]Resolved some mesh and texture issues reported
[*]Fixed font for Workshop map descriptions
[*]Fixed textures being shown incorrectly

[/list]

[h2]Suggestions for players that helped some people resolve game launch crashes[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Update Graphic card drivers[/b]
[*][b]Re-install DirectX12[/b]
[*][b]Verify integrity of game files[/b] (Steam → Game Right Click → Properties → Local Files → Verify Integrity of Game Files)
[*]From AMD control center, disable all driver-specific features like anti-lag or dynamic resolution.
[*]From the NVIDIA Control Panel, manage 3D settings and scroll until you find [i]shader cache size[/i]. Set it to 10 GB and ensure your boot drive has enough space.
[/list]

[h2]For people who experienced first launch crash or black screen[/h2]
[list]
[*]Go to your local app data folder: [code]C:\Users\[USERNAME]\AppData\Local[/code]  
(You can type [code]%localappdata%[/code] in the Windows search or Run dialog to jump there directly)
[*]Delete the folder [b]MasterOfRealms[/b] before trying to launch the application again.
[/list]

notes.title: First Hotfix is up!
notes.content:
[b]We just rolled out [i]Master of Realms – Hotfix v0.5.1 (2025-02-03)[/i]! Check out the latest changes and fixes below.[/b]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Changes & Improvements[/h2]
[list]
   [*][b]Framerate Limit setting[/b] – Control your max FPS for optimal performance.
   [*][b]Mountains[/b] – Now automatically delete when drawn over.
   [*][b]Option to delete Grid lines[/b] – Clean up your map layout more easily.
   [*][b]Radius/Brush size[/b] – Adjust with the [b][u][[/u][/b] and [b][u]][/u][/b] keys for quick fine-tuning.
   [*][b]Camera Controls Rework:[/b]
   [list]
      [*][b][u]Pan[/u][/b]: Middle Mouse + Drag
      [*][b][u]Rotate[/u][/b]: Right Mouse + Drag
      [*][b][u]Zoom[/u][/b]: Scroll
   [/list]
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
   [*][b]Empty map loading:[/b] No more getting stuck on a blank loading screen.
   [*][b]Multiple object duplication:[/b] Fixed orientation issues when duplicating.
   [*][b]Selection issues:[/b] Selecting objects in the same tile via rectangle now works properly.
   [*][b]Tile rotation & movement:[/b] Various bugs squashed.
   [*]Tiles will no longer disappear after drawing on top of them.
   [*]Resolved crashes when loading or closing a map.
   [*]Tile selection radius no longer changes when rotating a tile.
   [*]Grid size in Viewbox now correctly updates with Undo/Redo.
   [*]Empty CityRoad tiles have been fixed.
   [*]Tools no longer save undo history when drawing outside the grid.
   [*]Loading screen properly disappears after opening a map.
   [*]Grid size now saves correctly for Undo/Redo.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

We’re still working hard to implement your feedback and introduce new features. Development is ongoing, so please bear with us as we continue to refine and improve [b]Master of Realms[/b]. Thank you for your patience and support!
